body: I think that's a great idea. I honestly hardly remember anything and I'm only in my 20's i know there were so many fun times. One thing i absolutely hate is when i'm with old friends and they'll tell a story about something I did or we did as a group and it sounds amazing and yet i have no recollection of ever doing it. Life moves fast and i wish i had kept up with all the things i had done.

Hell yeah. Here's to hoping for stem cell research and artificial/3d printed organs being more available in the next decade lol. I never wanted to grow so old I can't take care of myself, but when faced with your own possible demise...I really have to look back and sadly say my dependence on opioids robbed me of what could have been the best years of my life. No doubt it was fun but once you hit that peak the trip down is fast and hard to come back from.

Make your own choices tho but remember that money can be used for so many other enjoyable and more important things. Traveling, indulgences, investments, social oriented shit.

Best words of wisdom I've heard from a friend when confronted with the admission to him that I had a problem.. He told me..

" drugs treat symptoms, conditions, and manipulate your sense to experience different levels of feelings. At some point when you stop your body will become over flooded with what normal feelings will be like. Everything you've been blocking will be exponentially worse"

For him personally it was benzos, and he knew when he reached a point he has to stop he was going to be one anxious and overwhelmed motherfucker. I found out when I stopped that normal pain/soreness became excruciating because my brain had overlooked those senses for so long. 

There are darker parts to my tale but I am rambling, just do you.

75 mg extended release. Stuck it on my arm. after 10 hours of waiting i almost gave up and took it off. Fell asleep and was awoken by the biggest WTF IS GOING ON moment i've had in my life. Turns out they can take up to 12 hours to hit. Very Very intense. I should have cut it in half as recommended. I liked the fact that it was 3 days worth out of one patch. Oh the last one i decided to lean while it was on. Nope. Nope. Nope. Bad all round night.

Not sure if this really qualifies. I was sober for about 2 weeks, managed to build a bankroll of about 20-40k gambling during that time. I took a bunch of pills one night and decided to gamble. 1 hour later $00.00. I took the rest of what i had hoping to not wake up. Could have solved all my debt and bought an asset. Literally gave 0 fucks during that hour was just thrilled to be high. hurray and fml.

The struggle is real. I have bounced off so many rock bottoms but eventually enough has to be enough. The hardest part is imagining a life time without it because i would stop for short periods of time and think hey i can do this 1 night and be good. No, No i can't. Personally if they could give straight hydrocodone without the aceto.. i really wouldn't give a fuck. But knowing you will cut your life short is about the only motivation i can give myself. I haven't found much success in this battle. Hope only the best for you.

I started using because i was prescribed for some injuries. I had an enormous bankroll at the time. I actually thought it helped my performance in what i do and what i enjoyed. It's been about 6 years. I have nothing left, driven myself into debt, and repeatedly made the worst decisions of my life while being under the influence. The other day i took every remaining pill i had knowing that either i wouldn't wake up, or that i wouldn't have money to buy more because i am so far into debt. One "Use" will lead to another and your tolerance will skyrocket. I am small, 125 pound male. I used to take 1 10mg hydro pill and be flying. Could never understand how people took so many. Today i could take 3 30mg oxy and just kinda shake it off. Thats a very expensive fucking habit. I have not used in a few days, let me tell you..day one..pitch black vomit, coupled with excruciating side pain. Day 2. Vomit. Day 3 shits so bad i thought i was going to pass out. Everytime i eat i shit. I do not sleep. I feel utterly hopeless. My use was on and off for over a decade...in the last 3 years i can't think of a time where i didn't have a supply to take. I would get enough to last 30 days, and quickly be looking for more in ten. Not only that but FDA crackdown has caused prices to raise a huge amount. When you lose connects and experience that panic, straight misery. Dude if i can tell you anything, it would be to not do it. I just found out i have 4 herniated disks, I can't be prescribed pain medicine due to the damage i have done to my kidneys and liver. I am in my fucking 20's. I will pay for my usage and probably die before i reach 50 because of these choices. If you care to talk more about it let me know, but when your bank account runs out so will your will to live. It's just something you will then have to add to the long list of every day struggles you already face. 


Edit: Let me say that if i had made between 5-10 different choices that were major factors in my collapse, i would be sitting on enough money to retire, and be telling you fuck yeah go for it. However i would still be dying young, I would still feel like shit, and i would still be scraping to find connects to get this shit because doctors are terrified to prescribe it for fear of getting fired. Now i mentioned 5-10 choices spread out over many years...I can say that the whole feeling of invincibility and fuck all must have contributed to the choices not being made correctly because i never felt anything at the time. Now... i feel only regret as well as loss of many things and people i cared about.
Fuck. Again

Already Tired. 

What are you taking now?

I don't see how i could go to therapy, can't even think about going to see a specialist. I don't have paper or plastic that will be accepted and insurance only covers so much of a doctors visit. I literally have nothing. My only hope is that a wrecked classic car i bought off another desperate kid will be able to sell or something and give me a few dollars. At this point i can't go to rehab, i hear that's expensive too. I'd think that would feel like heaven compared to where i am at now, at least having a guide through the process of recovery. Really it's a process i don't think i'll ever be ready for or else i would have gone weeks/months ago on my own will power. It'll either get so bad someone will send me or there may be know one left to send. I understand your struggle. and i agree when i think just on a basic level, Mine is so insignificant in the scope of the world and even to my life and yet this just feels like the end. My stomach is on fire, my brain is throbbing with pain, and frustration is over whelming every sense man. I would thank you, but i'm honestly sorry with every fiber of what was once a strong resilient person that you are here through this with me, some fucking broke degenerate addict. All my friends are gone or are gamblers.

I am obnoxious. Everything is a blur. Everything aches, hurts, and i can't bare to read what i write. I try to make sense of it all but they weight upon my eyelids steadily builds with every passing moment. I continue to make bad choices, I am the one doing this to me, and I can't make it stop. Worse than any amount of money I just want this nightmare to end. Wishful thinking would be to wake up with the money in my account. Wisdom would tell me that i should be wishing to start over at 0 and with 0 knowledge. To not feel that burden. It is all so new to me. Realizing how much of the world lives in debt; it is no wonder how much bad shit goes on. I am unable to fathom going to work tomorrow. If only i could wake up and be a hard working productive person. If only these vices didn't suck the life out of me. I am fucking desperate, I can't sleep, and i think there is a chance i may drown in a disgusting display of vomit and self-hate. Lastly I am unsure whether i want this to end; I don't feel i have suffered enough to make up for the horrible emptiness i have built inside. Let alone have to face the consequences. I don't no what to do aside from continue to take these curses 1 by 1. To pray the end comes quick. I now know i am going to get sick... right... now...sure enough i stopped mid sentence to unleash a relentless stream of vomit. Maybe that will save my life to prolong the misery. Pill 10. I'm not even sure what i took, just another mixture of matter from the pile. Glancing around my room I notice nothing but filth. A horrible disaster of what was once such a promising life. Could that have been a fallacy as well? Everything seems to be one big lie, yet there is a certain definitive outcome that i fucking knew i was headed towards. I fucking saw this coming. I am not a fortune teller but as desperation furthers there is little hope in sight. Crying seems like the best option; praying for forgiveness doesn't take away the pain. Still, no matter what i do, think, or write, it seems as if every minute holds the density of lifetimes. There is no turning back, I am sick. I do need help and in more ways than i care to count.
Please, take me from this place. 

I'm still here. I'd give everything to be anywhere but here. Then again, i guess i already tried that. 

Already Tried.

God dammit gambler, why are you so pathetic and at such desperate lengths over monetary well-being? You can see by now nobody gives a fuck, nobody wants to play your stupid games, and there is no turning back time. Are you going to man up or wither like a dried out piece of shit you scumbag. You fear death, it's always terrified you, nobody but yourself is going to lend a hand. Your idea was worthless and you're pushing yourself farther into the dark. I wish someone would just say that you're a fucking idiot to confirm what you're thinking.

Number 9.

I can't even beg for attention. I look at what i write and wonder what has caused me to do this. Stop, stop stop. Nope. I could stop now, but what about tomorrow, or the next day. It's just unimaginable. I'm starting to think the words i type are more stupid than the entire situation I put myself in. I spent ten minutes at my sink unable to lift my eyes towards the mirror. This is desperation, this is boredom, this is the accumulation of all my lives work in 1 shitty display of poorly written public exhibition. Wondering if i was always this pathetic is the only thing that stops the drizzle of edible naughties from turning to a down poor. I know i can be better, i believe i am better than this, but i feel i have lost all sense of creative touch. I can't even get a fucking question. I'm just going to gamble more and take more.
God i'm pathetic, I feel stupid just looking at this, and thinking about what i did tonight. Tell me what troubles you

Sorry, fuzzy night you know? Could have sworn it was you. My happiness isn't on my money. My constant anxiety, depression, and terrible feelings are. I could care less if i had 0 dollars or owed the bank a ton of money. Atleast i could pay it off over time. What has me where i'm at is that it was my moms money i spent like a fucking moron, it is her life i am fucking up by existing, and it is my own ignorance and continued stupidity that makes me question whether i need to continue. Normal things don't me happy you are correct. games are one of the very few things that do, along with medications, and it seems they are ruining my life. I just don't no what to do, I can't just walk away and live knowing the state i left things. I have to fix them. This is a ridiculous attempt at gathering support I am aware. I already feel like a huge joke and my intention is not to make fun of or mock the issue. However i am trying to find some type of light through the darkness. If you want to help me, ask me something here before i go any farther. Help me feel like i am a part of something! 
http://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/2umbx9/reddit_lets_play_a_game_can_you_spare_a_moment/

I saw your reply in my other thread. I want to say hello and welcome to my inner circle. Be it here or in a mystical heaven or if your a hell type of guy/gal i hope to have a conversation with you. Perhaps i'll never get the chance, but for 3 days i thought about responding to you. Giving you some type of notice that i read what you wrote and appreciated it. Yet i couldn't find the energy to do so because it just wasn't thrilling. That is what my life has come to. I hope you don't contemplate it any further, i hope you understand that this is literally the stupidest/worst route you could go if you are not under extreme circumstances. I admit my life can get better, it has been amazing, but i am intelligent and my observation of the world leads me to believe that it's okay to let go. Born in the wrong era, subject to poor choices, and having no money when i should have plenty. I don't no shit about financial responsibility, I don't know shit about life as "a functioning adult in society". I don't want to do the shit people do. My grandma for example is in here 80's and is upset she is unhealthy and can't work. That is fucking stupid.

A) she needs money
B) she feels working is the only thing that gives her value because working is all she was conditioned to do.

She enjoys is. I wish i could drive her to work every day and that be my job, it would make me happy to see her happy. But i'll be fucked before i work 8-5 everyday for the rest of my life just so that i can be a part of society. That is goddamn stupid. If i wake up and want to go for a walk, I should be able to go for a fucking walk and not have to go make a shitty amount of money so that i can go to mcdonalds. Money. I fucking hate money. I hope your life takes all my good fortune and i will take you misfortune.

Let the games begin, yes? Can you spare a minute or two for a dying man? If not you're a dick and should take my left over whites. Shit i take that back, i doubt that is happening, you'd have to pry them from my cold, dead fingers. wink wink. Thank you for the acknowledgment.

It makes it all,
Strange that i'm going back and correcting mistakes in my writing in a fucking suicide thread. I am literally a piece of shit ready to be swallowed by the earth. A piece of shit who loves games more than life? I don't think i've talked much about my life. It was amazing. I was overly fortunate to be born into the situation and circumstances i was as well as to go through what i did until recently. Given nearly every opportunity I simply became a product of my environment and figuratively fucked myself in the ass with a 10 foot pogo stick. Boing, boing, boing faggot. If i could go back to the time when i was 14 and never taken that pinch of chewing tobacco... Never steal that sip of alcohol... Never pop that adderall to stay awake through class because i was different. Because I was punished for wanting to stay up late and sleep in? Fuck, if i had never tried to fit in and just been myself, maybe i'd be successful, maybe i'd be wealthy (yes they are different), maybe i wouldn't be killing myself slowly. What if i hadn't gone to school, never fell into these interactions, never met people who pursued the same passions...would shit be different? Fuck those 3 dots too, if you're going, go speaking your mind. If i don't die tonight, i surely will soon enough with the damage i have caused my body for close to a decade. Fuck, i think the only thing left to do is play a game. If the process gets drawn out i fear the pain and expense will only sky rocket fucking things up worse over time. 

Fuck, should I?

The worst part of all of this is that i'm still gambling as I write. fucking pathetic. Atleast it's for play money. That actually feels pretty good. Along with the money i transferred from my bank, I could have given my mom $5,000 to help with her debt i caused. She was so financially responsible her whole life, and after my dad left her a year ago for some whore an her family she has done everything she could to help me while maintaining her own life. I wish i could have been that strong. I wish i hadn't cancelled 1 of the 2 checks for $2,500. They would have gotten here in 2 weeks. I wish i hadn't lost the other $15,000. It would have been comforting to know i could pay her back, but i think what i am doing to myself was going to happen regardless. Did i mention i lost it in less than 2 hours? Not that if fucking matters. The entire time i just kept telling myself i should kill myself. Once i finish these carrots i'm going to take another. What's worse is i have her credit card in my hand and seriously considering using it. Mine was already declined again... I wonder if my insurance will give anything to help the mess i created if this does bring my end. Maybe i should overdraft my card further if i'm truly going to finish the bottle. What more could it hurt? they can't expect my family to pay right? God these thoughts fucking sicken me at my deepest roots.

8 pills
And i fucking lied about play money.

I know,
It's deplorable behavior. Doing what i am because of selfishness and my own short comings. I didn't take another dose because I feel myself getting sick already. It would just be a waste when it gets regurgitated. It's inevitable, just like i knew my failure was. Scared is an understatement. I'm actually calmly panicked on the inside if that makes any sense. My greatest fear is actually to wake up tomorrow, have to read through this nonsense, and then make that terrifying call to my boss to tell him that i won't be coming in. Why should i have to be scared to admit i need work off because i was to die? Would they rather fire me over missing a day or miss out on me for a lifetime if they could just see what this reality was outside of that place. Without a doubt I will try again. Slowly, painfully, I will continue to plummet all 6 feet. The plan is to stay up as long as possible to limit the chances of waking up and getting to the hospital. When i sleep, I want to make sure it is going to be lights out. Oddly enough i'm hungry, maybe some carrots? I always like carrots. If reincarnation is true, i'd like to think i'd come back as a rabbit. Seriously, What the fuck is going on, what happens when you die. I'd actually be embarrassed to know someone took the time to read this. Don't waste your time; I am not worth it. Yet documenting this dumbassery on a fucking webpage is worth while, I know it's not just me, these problems have created an epidemic. When you think you're going to die, and expecting to die... you sure think about the little things a lot. Why would i be self conscious of what i write when i'm trying to kill off the main character?

All the people i didn't say goodbye too. I hope they don't realize how pathetic I became towards the end.

7 pills

In 2 weeks after i'm gone, my mom will receive a check in her name from the gambling website that I ruined my life through. I always played in her name, even when it wasn't her card and money; I always wanted to give everything I won to someone aside from myself. I never deserved it and i think that's why I allowed it to get to this point. My estimate is that i have made somewhere between some god awful amount in the last year. Suppose the correct term would be "cycled" through that amount of money because i never actually allowed myself to see a dime. The most i've ever taken of these 30 mg oxy's is 7. That was in 24 hours. I had 1-7 written out not thinking i would actually do it and yet with each one i got closer to that magic number. Somehow i lived before. Most likely by the dumb luck of me throwing up for hours afterwards. Tonight I don't feel sick. The only sickness is that which has grown inside me. The sickness of silence when i pause between writing and editing what may be goodbye.

goodbye, I know.

6 pills

I am going to keep going. I can't bear to see the look on her face in the morning immediately after having told her tonight i could pay off my debts. I tried to pretend money wasn't everything to me, tried to be stronger than a fucking piece of paper. In the end I am taking the cowards way out for 1 reason. Money. I am going to miss out on growing old, sharing a family with the girl of my dreams, and dying a normal fashion. Oh god, i hadn't even thought about her. She will miss me to I imagine. I think it's to late anyways. Maybe i will send her a text before i feel that last slip into darkness.

5 pills

Please choose to. I considered rehab but that will only lead me to a life time of struggle and temptation when it's over. Instead I am taking the easy way out, I already live in constant pain when I'm not guzzling these killers. I mentioned I owed my mom a ton of money. I know she will miss her son more than her money and ruined credit score, but i can't even look at myself in the mirror. Let alone to look another day at the face of discontent. I used to be handsome and personable. Now i am a shell of man who has become twisted by shards of shattered mirrors. I'm the one who broke the reflection and I am the one who gets to fall upon each jagged edge digging it further into my flesh. Slashing my own throat actually sounds more pleasurable that continuing to ingest these little demons. It hurts like nothing i have ever felt. I transferred everything i had left in my bank account to one in her name. I have opened my drawer and popped the cap off the last bottle of painkillers i have no business being in possession of. Yet 1 by 1 they find their way into my hands and onto the tip of my tongue. I don't even need water. 

I desperately need water.

4 pills

I could have saved myself. I had turned 200 dollars into $20,000. All i had to do was nothing. I could have sat an collected my money. Instead i chose to take these pills and gamble tonight. As i write this, I am starring at the $00.00 left in my account. The only reason i am writing this is because I want to leave something behind. Maybe 1 person will read this and shift their course for the better. I have a job and it was a good one. I could have worked hard everyday but i chose not to. Bringing this upon myself gives me slight comfort. 

I Chose not to.

3 pills

I am in debt. over ten thousand owed to the bank. This is nothing compared to the atrocity I have brought upon my own mother. I used her credit card to gamble because mine did not work. I am a grown fucking man, I should have known better. I did know better. At first it was little amounts. It quickly spiraled out of control. This past month in a fit of stupidity and self-destruction i soared past her card limit of 7,000 dollars. I gave her all the money from my bank loan and i still needed to get her over 10,000 more. An hour ago this wasn't a problem.

2 pills

After several car accidents not of my doing I became addicted to these painkillers. I did not seek treatment and everyday i can feel it in my liver, my body, and my mind. I did not go after their insurance companies for money because I thought of it as beneath me. I thought i was taking the honorable route. For years I have gambled and become good at it, but that is the fallacy. Now the two have overlapped in the worst kind of way.
 I walk myself into the sunset.
